capabilities: Hatch a per-vault ASCII pet with persistent traits, rarity and stats
React to writing bursts, pauses, revisions and note activity with short quips
Chat directly and ask about the current note
Track session modes, moods and recurring writing patterns
Customize species, hat, rarity, color and stats via commands
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory, so it must be built and installed manually. Fully functional without an API key via local fallbacks, and the README documents intentional limits (no autonomous edits, no full chat transcript, no cross-vault sync).
problem: Obsidian has no lightweight, non-intrusive companion that reacts to writing sessions, and AI plugins typically take the form of full chat assistants.
summary: Sidebar pet companion that hatches a per-vault ASCII buddy which reacts to your writing and offers short LLM-generated quips.
